title: Eligibility Criteria Released for World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: This circular outlines the essential eligibility requirements for Indian players aspiring to represent the nation at the BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued a circular detailing the eligibility criteria for players seeking selection for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026, scheduled to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Bhubaneswar U-19 Tournament Now World Junior Championships Selection Event
indian_angle: The Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament has been designated as the crucial selection event for Indian players aiming for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: The Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament has been postponed, and the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament will now serve as the official selection event for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change to a 3x15 scoring system will be implemented across all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.

title: Dates Changed for All India Sub-Junior National Ranking Tournaments
indian_angle: Indian sub-junior players and their coaches need to note the revised schedules for key national ranking tournaments in Jaipur and Patna.
summary: The dates for the Yonex-Sunrise All India Sub-Junior National Ranking Badminton Tournaments (U-15 & U-17 in Jaipur, U-13 in Patna) have been changed, requiring participants to check the new schedule.

title: Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Tournament in Chennai Announced
indian_angle: This circular announces a significant domestic senior ranking tournament in Chennai, providing a crucial platform for top Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released a circular for the Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2026, scheduled to take place in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, from July 16th to 23rd, 2026.
